Invoice basics

Everything a new business owner should know before creating an invoice

Is it really free?

The invoice creation and preview flow is free. Signup or login is required when you want to save the invoice and download the PDF.

Why preview before signup?

Previewing first helps you confirm the invoice looks right and gives new users confidence before creating an account.

Best use cases

Freelancers, consultants, contractors, local shops and service businesses can use it for quick customer billing.

What happens after signup?

The invoice can be attached to your account so you can download it, edit it later and track payment.

Practical tips

Invoice details that help clients pay faster

Keep item names clear and short so customers understand the bill quickly.
Use a due date even for small invoices so payment expectations are clear.
Add a note for UPI, bank transfer or other payment instructions.
Preview totals before saving so tax and discount mistakes are caught early.
Use PDF download after signup when sharing with serious clients.

How it works

From blank invoice to PDF in a few steps

1

2

3

4

5

FAQs

Can I create an invoice without signup?

Yes. You can create and preview the invoice before signup. Signup is required to save and download the PDF.

Can I add GST or tax?

Yes. You can add tax percentage on invoice line items when needed.

Can I download the invoice as PDF?

Yes. PDF download is available after signup or login.

Is this useful for freelancers?

Yes. Freelancers can bill clients for projects, hourly work, retainers and services.

Can I use it on mobile?

Yes. The public invoice maker is designed to work on mobile and desktop.

Will my invoice be saved after signup?

The public invoice flow is designed to attach your invoice to your account after signup or login.
